CHANGELOG updated in DUNG: Initial NORTHSTAR scoping pass: DUNG, the BURROW editor. Founder-corrected twice in real time -- moved out of BURROW into its own standalone, Bazel-built repo; editor domain is a ground-up port of PARENA's own stdlib/editor/*.prn, compiled via the real burrow CLI (BURROW's own real, live, flagship dogfooding consumer). Real UX foundation adopted directly from EmilyOS's own gui-v0.1-design-capture.md (tmux x i3 hybrid layout). Real blocker named: burrow build isn't implemented yet, gated on BURROW's own Phase 3-4. Scoping only, no code yet. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
